name: Diego Macías Vega
tagline: Final-year science student in Madrid, applying for 2027 entry to Aerospace Engineering, Applied Physics and Advanced Technology

sections.title: Profile
lines: I build software on physics and mathematics and check it against measurement: reproduced baselines, validation suites and published negative results. I work with AI coding assistants and say so: the code is largely AI-written; the questions, the rules each project obeys, the decisions and the responsibility for every claim are mine.

entries.head: Bachillerato in Sciences and Technology
entries.org: IES San Agustín del Guadalix, Madrid
bullets: Mathematics II, Physics, Technology and Engineering, Computer Science. Final year; graduating June 2027.

entries.head: University applications, September 2027 entry
bullets: BSc Aerospace Engineering, TU Delft (selection exam) · BSc Applied Physics, TU Eindhoven · BSc Advanced Technology, University of Twente.

entries.head: RAAN · Open Orbital Intelligence Lab
bullets: Reproducible lab on public orbital data. Digital twin of 20,152 catalogued objects propagated with SGP4; propagator checked against Vallado's 666 reference vectors (max difference 3.5e-5 km).
ESA Collision Avoidance Challenge: naive forecast reproduced exactly (L = 0.694). Best model scores 0.627 on the test set but fails cross-validation; reported as a negative result.
Manoeuvre detection on 15 satellites, leave-one-satellite-out: F1 0.81 (classifier), 0.74 (physics baseline), 0.09 (chance). 6-page technical report.
Code mostly written by an AI coding assistant and reviewed by an independent session; I set the question and the rules and answer for every claim.

entries.head: QEC Lab
bullets: Open lab comparing neural decoders with minimum-weight perfect matching on the surface code. Under construction; no results yet.

entries.head: gravity-lab
bullets: N-body simulator of the Solar System validated against measurement: reproduces Mercury's relativistic perihelion precession (42.81 arcsec/century; accepted 42.98, error 0.4 %).
Four integrators compared; Yoshida 4 (symplectic) holds energy error at 1.4e-11 over 100 years. 31 validation cases in CI. Browser build online.

entries.head: KAIROS
bullets: Local-first personal AI assistant: 17 agents, 300+ tests, sandboxed self-modification that never merges without my approval. Architecture and decisions mine (77 written decision records); Claude as pair programmer.

entries.head: Other
bullets: Chess trainer (Stockfish and Maia, explanations fact-checked by test) · Quant Path (drills and 110 code-verified problems for quantitative trading) · TraceGuard (firmware changes checked against safety rules; paused MVP) · Sympto+ (multilingual health-information web app; paused).
